draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.10, the 149th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 16th of 29 at CB. He lasted until pick 183, well after his grade rank (149th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 passes defended in 2024, 16th of 29 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans. 14 career games and 5 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 0.0% (98th percentile), completion % allowed 48.4% (96th percentile), passer rating allowed 74.0 (86th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 cornerback who played: 32.2% season snap share against a median of 27.6%, above the norm.
